json.justification: Photo 1 (before install) shows the meter on a clear brick wall with open space to its left and a free wall below it. It also shows a fenced grassy backyard with no drivable surface, pool, or gas meter visible anywhere along this wall. There is ample room on the same wall within a few feet of the meter for a 2x2x3 ft battery, with a continuous, uninterrupted wall for the wiring run, as confirmed by the later install photos.
